<!-- pr-reviewer: deb2f142b23b401f2dd3175da4c1fe9c81d55de6 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The display fix places the box bottom at Z=0 and preserves its height and X/Y bounds. The lathe path stays unchanged.
The new tests cover the bundled machine files, a shifted origin, and an inverted Z axis.

Local results against upstream/main at cda3d58965843c30c6c70d59c06ac27c4dcda8b0:
- The trial merge reported "Already up to date." There were no conflicts.
- The quick gate dry-run selected the UI library and four integration suites.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 817 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- Integration suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 6 passed; `sinker_setup` 2 passed; `theme_files` 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff upstream/main --check`: passed.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/work_envelope.rs:56` and the PR body: add before/after screenshots of the changed viewport display. The body has no screenshots. Use the same machine, setup, and camera for both images. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body. Do not add images to this PR branch.

Safety and test notes:
- This is a display-only change. The changed output goes to `interact::collect_overlay`. No posting, travel, collision, stock simulation, or model geometry check uses it.
- This is not a safety-tier review. I did not repeat the author's mutations. Red/green mutation results are not independently verified.
- No goldens changed. I did not run the native application or pixel snapshot tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The requested before/after screenshots are now linked in the PR body.
Both images use the same Tormach machine, implicit setup, and camera.
The application UI and GPU viewport produced both images.
Only the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch contains the images (commit `47aaf61f29060a486d1603b8ddbe61ae58e09377`).

The existing pins check the displayed envelope:
- `mill_envelope_stands_on_table_for_all_travel_files`
- `mill_envelope_stays_on_table_with_shifted_origin_and_inverted_z`

Both pins failed with the display fix reverted. Both passed after restoration.
`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 817 unit tests and 25 integration tests.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Head: `deb2f142b23b401f2dd3175da4c1fe9c81d55de6`.
The head is unchanged because this finding needs only screenshots and a PR body update.
The push reported that the branch is up to date. The PR remains a draft.
Please re-review the requested screenshots.

<!-- pr-reviewer: deb2f142b23b401f2dd3175da4c1fe9c81d55de6 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I withdraw the earlier request for changes on this head. The PR body now links the required before/after screenshots. I opened both images. They show the same machine, setup, camera, and UI, with the envelope moved upward after the fix. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. This PR changes no image files.

The body also records red/green results for both value tests. The tests cover bundled machine files, a shifted work origin, and inverted Z. Both tests passed during this review.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `2f6de7c5b0eb7eb9053ce086a8e4705fc0776a78`:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: 817 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- Integration suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 6 passed; `sinker_setup` 2 passed; `theme_files` 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff upstream/main --check`: passed.

The quick gate dry-run selected batch verification because its comparison included upstream changes in the uncommitted trial merge. The local checks above cover the PR's changed UI code. No GitHub runner was used.

Safety and test notes:
- This change affects only the displayed envelope. Its output goes to `interact::collect_overlay`.
- Posting, travel, gouge, collision, stock simulation, and model geometry checks do not use the changed output. This is not a safety-tier review.
- I did not repeat the author's mutations. Their red/green results remain author evidence.
- No goldens changed. The native application and pixel snapshot tests were not run.

Requested changes: none. The earlier screenshot finding is answered. No code change is required for that finding.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
